name: qarib
description: Qarīb: nearest masjids, jamaat times and prayer times. PWA + iOS/Android via Capacitor.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android

qarib.minNativeNote: Raise when the Android shell changes (new plugin or permission): older APKs then get the APK notice instead of a silent update.
